hypothesis.statement: On the real occipital O1-Oz pair, the debiased wPLI is low (consistent with the PLI case -- the alpha coupling is mostly volume conduction); weightedPLI reproduces an independent scipy imaginary-cross-spectrum wPLI; and the debiasing works -- for INDEPENDENT signals the biased wPLI is spuriously positive but the debiased wPLI is ~0, while genuine lagged coupling stays ~1.

analysis_plan.dataset: EEG Motor Movement/Imagery Database (eegmmidb, PhysioNet), subject S002 baseline run R02 (eyes-closed), occipital channels O1 and Oz, first 10 s at 160 Hz (1600 samples each)

decision.threshold: descriptive: weightedPLI equals an independent scipy wPLI to < 1e-2 (agreement), and the debiasing works -- for independent signals the biased wPLI > 0.01 (spurious) while the debiased wPLI < 0.01 (corrected), and lagged coupling keeps a debiased wPLI > 0.9; the real O1-Oz debiased wPLI is low
